We're looking for someone who is highly organised, dependable and comfortable managing multiple priorities. You'll need excellent attention to detail, strong communication skills and the confidence to liaise with colleagues, senior managers and external providers.

You should have:
- Previous experience in a varied administrative, coordination or business support role
- Excellent organisational and time-management skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook
- Strong attention to detail and accurate data-entry skills
- Confidence dealing with telephone calls, emails and correspondence
- Experience coordinating meetings, events or similar activities would be beneficial
- The ability to work independently, manage deadlines and proactively follow up outstanding information

The Opportunity

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established regional team in a varied role with real exposure to senior management, whilst also taking ownership of an important area of training administration.

Salary: Up to 35,000 basic salary + package
Location: Birmingham

If you're an experienced administrator looking for a role with variety, responsibility and the opportunity to work closely with senior stakeholders, we'd love to hear from you.

Generic Responsibilities All staff at Kingstanding Circle Surgery have a duty to conform to the following: Equality, Diversity & Inclusion A good attitude and positive action towards ED&I creates and environment where all individuals are able to achieve their full potential. Creating such an environment is important for three reasons: it improves operational effectiveness, it is morally the right thing to do, and it is required by law. Patients and their families have the right to be treated fairly and be routinely involved in decisions about their treatment and care. They can expect to be treated with dignity and respect and will not be discriminated against on any grounds including age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex or sexual orientation. All staff will be required to partake and complete mandatory training as directed by the training coordinator, as well as participating in the practice training programme. title: Administrative assistant
